Lab 5

RAG Pipeline

@llm-series/chunker@llm-series/embedder@llm-series/vector-store-lite@llm-series/retriever

Retrieval-Augmented Generation: split documents into chunks → embed with OpenAI → store vectors → find similar chunks for a query → build context → generate answer.

💡 Retriever.addDocument() chunks + embeds in one call. retrieve() embeds the query and finds closest vectors by cosine similarity. The LLM only sees the retrieved chunks as context.
